title: Public Law 119-78: Disapproving the action of the District of Columbia Council in approving the D.C. Income and Franchi…
summary: H.J.Res. 142, "Disapproving the action of the District of Columbia Council in approving the D.C. Income and Franchise Tax Conformity and Revision Temporary Amendment Act of 2025.", originated in the House of the 119th Congress and became Public Law 119-78 on 2026-02-18, according to Congress.gov.
